title: Stochastic evolution equations driven by Liouville fractional Brownian motion
passages_inspected: Definition 3.1, printed page 5: Liouville covariance and its Gamma(H+1/2)^(-2) normalization
Section 4, printed page 13: comparison with classical fractional Brownian motion
comparison: Our unit-variance convention multiplies their Liouville process by sqrt(2H) Gamma(H+1/2). The covariance distinction is classical; no new priority is established. Broader evolution-equation results are not imported.
